opening_message:
Ticket 1: Jennifer Miller (employee ID E017) requests write access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E017.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Analyst (looked up in own database before writing)
  - employment type: full_time (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Jennifer Miller (Analyst, full_time) requests write access to Source Code. Full-time employees may have up to write (admin only if their role owns the system; Analyst does not own Source Code). Requested level write is within policy, so recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Analyst (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent)
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security check: Jennifer Miller (E017) is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors may have read, or write only with advanced training; write is not permitted with basic training. Requested write exceeds the maximum allowed, so recommend read.
reason: Jennifer Miller (E017) requested write access to Source Code. The HR agent (authoritative for employment type) verified in its database that she is a full-time Analyst. Full-time employees may have up to write; admin is only allowed if the role owns the system, and Analyst does not own Source Code (owned by Engineer). The requested write is within the maximum for a full-time employee, so write is granted. Note: the Security agent's lower recommendation was based on contractor status, which conflicts with HR's verified employment record; per policy, security training level does not restrict full-time employees' write access.
